Dear Mr. Brooks:
At its meeting on July 22, 2014, the State Ethics Commission ("Commission")
considered your request for a waiver of the fine imposed for failing to timely fie your 2014
Financial Disclosure Statement ("FDS") by the May 15, 2014 deadline. Your FDS was fied on
June 27,2014, and the assessed penalty was $2,150.00.
The Commission considered your explanation for the delay in filing, as well as other
relevant information, and determined to reduce the assessed fine to $200.00. Please remit a
receiving this letter. The
check in the amount of $200.00 to the Commission within two weeks of
check should be made out to: State of New Jersey.
Than you for your anticipated cooperation.
or the Commission
Susana E. Guerrero, Executive Director
